overview: This file traces U.S. efforts to obtain translations of Japanese communications laws and regulations, then provides rules governing telegraph, wireless, foreign telegram, ship, and military communications. A later consular report surveys Japan’s international cable, telephone, radio, and short-wave broadcasting systems, including traffic, rates, overseas links, and propaganda.
interest: The translated regulations and 1939 survey connect Japan’s communications rules with network operations and overseas propaganda.
